title: Remember the last saved visitor nickname
goal: uses localStorage to write a string, and when the page is opened again, use the same key to read it.
summary: Visitors can save a nickname. The save button updates the current page, and you can read the same value when you open this level again.
tasks: page opens, read visitorNickname from localStorage and display it in #saved-name. "No nickname yet" is displayed when there is no record.
When "Save" is clicked, the nickname after removing the leading and trailing blanks from the input box is saved to visitorNickname, and #saved-name is updated.
retains existing empty text checks, and empty nicknames do not overwrite saved values.

example.note: Map page can save distance units with one key. setItem writes text and getItem reads the same key. getItem returns null when the key has never been written.

hint: needs to update the page after saving, and getItem must also be executed when the page is loaded. Only modify the text when you click Save, and it will return to the default content after reopening.
